requirements.title: Session Persistence Store
requirements.description: Session metadata (ID, created_at, last_connected, shell command) persisted in database. Sessions default to never-expire policy.

validation.notes: Session metadata stored and retrievable after create
Session list returns all active sessions
List sessions handler returns JSON array
Session management renders the current pane list, its empty state, and session actions
BAS case verifies sessions remain listed by API after workspace/sessions route transitions
BAS case reloads workspace and verifies same session ID and marker output are restored
Idempotency cache TTL expiry removes stale entries on Get
Idempotency cache eviction scan triggered at >100 entries

requirements.title: When an Operator Closes a Session, Archive It
requirements.description: When an operator closes a session, web-console MUST archive its metadata and conversation without permanent deletion, MUST make archived message text retrievable across sessions, and MUST require a confirmed explicit action for permanent deletion.

validation.notes: Archive preserves conversation data, supports undo, and returns collapsed reopen lineages with honest restore states
Cross-session archive search uses FTS5 and excludes live sessions
The UI close action archives and never invokes permanent deletion
The archive drawer searches messages, reads transcripts, reopens sessions, and owns crash-orphan recovery actions

requirements.title: Reconnect State Restoration
requirements.description: Reconnecting WebSocket re-attaches to the existing PTY process. Client receives buffered output generated while disconnected.

validation.notes: Offline buffer delivers output generated while disconnected
Fake PTY offline buffer replay works correctly
BAS case disconnects terminal websocket and verifies delayed output replay on reconnect

requirements.title: Offline Buffer Replay
requirements.description: Offline buffer replays accumulated output in order when client reconnects. Buffer has bounded size to prevent memory exhaustion.

validation.notes: Offline buffer replay delivers output in order
